## Changes: * #4812: Fix premature compaction: decouple ratio from tool tokens, raise thresholds * #4811: Add transcript line count to compaction summary * #4807: make sure to not continue if is false for tool call images * #4805: PromptsServiceImpl: avoid using openTextDocument to not trigger validations * #4803: Sessions - adopt new context key, update action icon * #4799: Sessions - update workspace tracker so that it uses file watcher instead of the git extension API * #4801: fix: address review feedback on OTel agent activity metrics * #4798: Sessions - setup tracking for initial workspace folder * #4756: Copilot CLI: refactor how uncommitted changes are determined before creating a new CLI session * #4797: fix - update command condition for chat session
See More * #4794: feat: add OTel events and metrics for agentic edit quality signals * #4796: Fix possible race with external ingest not seeing code search repos * #4795: Clean up a bit more legacy code around workspace chunk search * #4792: Add OTel metrics for edit acceptance and code survival telemetry * #4790: Slash command telemetry cleanup * #4787: Session - add confirmation dialog for discarding changes * #4789: sessions: add PR detection debug logging * #4742: Support dynamic prompt variables * #4781: Sessions - add action to discard changes * #4780: sessions: extend delegated PR lookup retry window * #4779: sessions: harden cloud session option and log parsing * #4777: Sessions - update button label * #4778: feat(auth): Enhance GitHub session handling with detailed prompts * #4771: Make sure IAgentSessionsWorkspace is registered for claude too * #4774: Claude harness: ignore `x-api-key`, authenticate only via `Authorization: Bearer` * #4773: fix: preserve full MCP tool schemas for Anthropic API * #4760: nes: permissive rebasing only works for auto-close pairs * #4767: Process rate limits and quota from WebSocket * #4757: fix: Copilot Chat issue template URL * #4706: Issue template isn't linked correctly to vscode repository * #4765: Sessions - enable checkpoint creation for all sessions * #4769: Use VS code org to determine team membership This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=425348&view=logs).
